usdRate.note: Bank of the Lao PDR reference rate page could not be read (certificate error); World Bank 2025 average was 20,444 (PA.NUS.FCRF).

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Lao Statistics Bureau, consumer price index
inflation_cpi.note: 7.7% year on year in October 2026 (CPI 279.5), down from 7.8% in September.

inflation_projection.sourceName: ADB Asian Development Outlook September 2026 forecasts (8.0% 2026, 6.5% 2027); Bank of the Lao PDR
inflation_projection.note: Inflation was above 20% in 2022-2024 and is easing toward ADB's 6.5% forecast for 2027, so we plan with a rounded 6% rather than the distorted 5-year average.

policy_rate.sourceName: Bank of the Lao PDR Monetary Policy Committee decision of 20 August 2026 (Laotian Times)
policy_rate.note: 7-day base interest rate cut from 8% to 7%; secondary source because the BOL website certificate could not be verified.

savings_account_rate.note: Searched the Bank of the Lao PDR site (unreachable, certificate error) and large bank rate pages (only 2019 and 2021 PDF rate sheets found); no current kip savings rate found.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No current published kip 3-month fixed deposit rate found; bank rate sheets online date from 2019-2021, before the 2022-2024 inflation and rate rises.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No current published kip 1-year fixed deposit rate found; bank rate sheets online date from 2019-2021.

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit product or rate found; large banks list only savings and fixed deposits.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: World Bank FR.INR.DPST for Laos stops at 2010 (3%), far too old; no recent weighted average deposit rate found.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No standing government savings certificate; the Bank of the Lao PDR and Ministry of Finance have sold occasional short-term savings bonds to residents (e.g. 6-month bonds at 15% in 2023), with no current issue found.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No published 91-day treasury bill yield found.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No published 5-year kip government bond yield found; government bonds are issued irregularly via the Lao Securities Exchange.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No published 10-year kip government bond yield found.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Lao PDR, income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: Interest on bank deposits and bonds is not subject to personal income tax.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Lao PDR, income determination
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No savings certificate exists; interest on bonds is not subject to personal income tax.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: A Deposit Protection Fund exists in Laos, but its website was unreachable and no current cover limit per depositor could be read.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or typical credit card rate found.

equity_return_low.sourceName: Lao Securities Exchange record; Bank of the Lao PDR policy rate
equity_return_low.note: The Lao Securities Exchange is very small and its index has fallen over the past decade, so the low case is zero in kip terms.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Policy rate 7% plus a small premium; weak local index record
equity_return_base.note: With a weak, illiquid local market we set the base only about 1 point above the 7% policy rate, well within 4 points of the tax-free safe rate.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Policy rate plus a full equity premium
equity_return_high.note: High case if listings deepen and returns keep pace with kip inflation.

gold_return_low.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend; kip exchange rate (22,518 per USD, Oct 2026)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: gold flat in dollars with mild kip depreciation.

gold_return_base.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend; kip exchange rate (22,518 per USD, Oct 2026, vs 20,444 average in 2025)
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 5% plus about 4% a year of expected kip depreciation.

gold_return_high.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend; kip exchange rate history
gold_return_high.note: High case for a strong gold cycle combined with renewed kip weakness.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Bank of the Lao PDR policy rate (7%); tax-free deposit interest
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case well below the policy rate, as banks pay less on short deposits. Safe LAK rates: no current published bank deposit rates found; Bank of the Lao PDR 7-day base rate 7% (Aug 2026); interest on deposits and bonds is exempt from personal income tax; inflation 7.7% (Oct 2026).

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Bank of the Lao PDR policy rate (7%); tax-free deposit interest
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case below the 7% policy rate since no current bank deposit rates could be verified. Safe LAK rates: no current published bank deposit rates found; Bank of the Lao PDR 7-day base rate 7% (Aug 2026); interest on deposits and bonds is exempt from personal income tax; inflation 7.7% (Oct 2026).

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Bank of the Lao PDR policy rate (7%); tax-free deposit and bond interest
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case at the policy rate, reachable with longer fixed deposits or government bonds. Safe LAK rates: no current published bank deposit rates found; Bank of the Lao PDR 7-day base rate 7% (Aug 2026); interest on deposits and bonds is exempt from personal income tax; inflation 7.7% (Oct 2026).

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry claim settlement ratio published by the Ministry of Finance insurance supervisor was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term life premium rates or credible premium guide in kip found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premium rates found.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure, SH.XPD.OOPC.CH.ZS)

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Lao Statistics Bureau CPI; Laotian Times report that health and medicine prices rose in Sep 2026
goal_inflation_health.note: No health sub-index figure was published; with 45% of health spending out of pocket we plan 2 points above the 6% inflation projection.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Lao Statistics Bureau CPI education group, +18.8% year on year in Sep 2026 (Laotian Times)
goal_inflation_education.note: Education prices are rising far faster than the headline CPI, so we plan 4 points above the inflation projection.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN)

life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years derived from expected age at death by current age (2026); secondary source for UN WPP.

support_ratio.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024, medium variant (via populationpyramid.net)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 7.4 in 2025, 10.6 in 2040 and 23.6 in 2065.

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Lao pension rules effective 2 June 2025 (Laotian Times)
retirement_age_default.note: Full pension at 60 with 25 years of social security contributions; the rules allow retirement from 57 for men and 55 for women in some circumstances.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: Lao pension rules effective 2 June 2025 (Laotian Times)
retirement_age_government.note: Civil servants are covered by the same national social security scheme; the article does not give a separate civil-service age, so verify (women may retire from 55).

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Bank of the Lao PDR policy rate (7%); tax-free deposit interest
retirement_return_low.note: Low case for kip deposits in retirement. Safe LAK rates: no current published bank deposit rates found; Bank of the Lao PDR 7-day base rate 7% (Aug 2026); interest on deposits and bonds is exempt from personal income tax; inflation 7.7% (Oct 2026).

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Bank of the Lao PDR policy rate (7%); tax-free deposit interest
retirement_return_base.note: Base case below the policy rate, as a stand-in for the tax-free 1-year deposit rate that could not be verified. Safe LAK rates: no current published bank deposit rates found; Bank of the Lao PDR 7-day base rate 7% (Aug 2026); interest on deposits and bonds is exempt from personal income tax; inflation 7.7% (Oct 2026).

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Bank of the Lao PDR policy rate (7%)
retirement_return_high.note: High case at the policy rate. Safe LAK rates: no current published bank deposit rates found; Bank of the Lao PDR 7-day base rate 7% (Aug 2026); interest on deposits and bonds is exempt from personal income tax; inflation 7.7% (Oct 2026).

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Mix of kip deposits and local equity
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: mostly deposits, equity flat.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Mix of kip deposits and local equity
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: About half equity at 8% and half deposits near 5.5%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Mix of kip deposits and local equity
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: About 60% equity at the high case and 40% deposits or bonds.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age pension found; the national social security scheme pays only contributory pensions and lump sums.

gratuity_rule.note: The Labour Law provides severance only when a contract is terminated; no statutory end-of-service gratuity on retirement found.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Lao pension rules effective 2 June 2025 (Laotian Times)
public_pension_scheme.note: National social security pension (LSSO): full pension at 60 with 25 years of contributions, 1% cut per missing year down to 23 years; otherwise a lump sum of 85% x 1.5 months of final salary per contribution year. No automatic indexation is described.

savings_account.localName: ເງິນຝາກປະຢັດ

fdr_3m.localName: ເງິນຝາກມີກຳນົດ
fdr_3m.note: Banks offer kip fixed deposits from 3 to 60 months; current rates not published online.

fdr_1y.localName: ເງິນຝາກມີກຳນົດ

dps.note: No common monthly recurring deposit product found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No standing government savings certificate; occasional short-term savings bonds have been sold to residents.

tbill_91d.note: No retail treasury bill market found.

tbond_5y.localName: ພັນທະບັດລັດຖະບານ
tbond_5y.note: Government bonds are issued irregularly via the Lao Securities Exchange; no regular 5-year retail issue.

tbond_10y.note: No 10-year kip government bond for retail investors found.

equity_fund.note: No retail mutual or index funds found; the Lao Securities Exchange lists only a few companies.

gold.note: Gold is widely bought from gold shops.

insuranceComplaints.name: Ministry of Finance (insurance supervision)
insuranceComplaints.note: No separate insurance ombudsman found; complaints go to the Ministry of Finance.
